## Games

### Trier Defeats Bamberg 92:79 in German Basketball League

*Played Saturday, 07 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

The VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier secured a convincing 92:79 victory over the BMA365 Bamberg Baskets in the German Basketball League. Jordan Roland led the way for Trier with 20 points, including his 1,000th Bundesliga point. The win marked Trier's fifth consecutive victory in the league, with a perfect 5-0 record in the Hinrunde. Bamberg, on the other hand, suffered their fourth loss of the season, dropping to 4-4. The Bamberger were unable to take the lead in the game, with Trier dominating from the start. Bamberg's Hason Ward and Richard Balint scored 17 points each, but it was not enough to overcome Trier's strong performance. The game was played in front of 5,570 spectators in the SWT-Arena in Trier, with the Trierers taking control from the beginning and never looking back.

### Vechta edge Chemnitz in high-scoring BBL clash

*Played Saturday, 07 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

Rasta Vechta secured their second consecutive easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga win with a 99-90 victory over NINERS Chemnitz on November 7. The Niedersachsen team, led by Head Coach Christian Held, took the lead in the standings, surpassing the Sachsen. Tommy Kuhse was the top scorer for Vechta with 22 points, while Tibor Pleiß achieved a double-double with 13 points and 12 rebounds. The decisive third quarter saw Vechta outscore Chemnitz 33-14, with Kuhse contributing two consecutive three-pointers and Justin Edler-Davis adding two three-pointers. Vechta's strong rebounding and three-point shooting were key factors in their win, with 49 rebounds to Chemnitz's 31 and 39% three-point shooting. The teams will meet again on December 13 in the Netto BBL Cup quarterfinals.

### Bamberg Baskets Start Rückrunde in BCL gegen UCAM Murcia

The Bamberg Baskets will begin their Champions League (BCL) return leg against UCAM Murcia on Wednesday. The Spanish team, currently 10th in the ACB, has won two of their three BCL games so far and are second in Group D behind Peristeri Betsson. The Baskets, led by head coach Jesús Ramírez, are expecting a lively atmosphere in the Palacio de los Deportes, with around 4,000 fans supporting their team in Murcia so far. UCAM Murcia has won three of their four home games in the ACB, including a 85-58 victory over Varese, but lost 72-80 to Peristeri. The game will be broadcast live on MagentaSport, starting at 20:20, with commentary by Markus Krawinkel.

### Gladiators Trier face long journey to Batumi for FIBA Europe Cup match

The Gladiators Trier will face a challenging journey to Batumi for their FIBA Europe Cup match, with a total travel time of over 15 hours to get there and 15 hours to return. According to Katharina Arnold, the team's Head of Sport Operations, the team will fly from Frankfurt to Tiflis via Istanbul on Tuesday, and return on Thursday morning via Istanbul and Luxembourg. Due to the time difference, the team will arrive at the hotel in Tiflis at midnight German time, which is 3am local time. The team will spend the day of the match on Wednesday according to German time, and the game will start at 5pm local time. The Gladiators are the undefeated leaders of their group with five wins, while Batumi is the bottom team with no wins. Coach Jacques Schneider wants his team to dominate the game for 40 minutes and hopes for a similar decisive win in the return match.

### Gladiators Trier Face Long-Haul Flight to BC Batumi

The VET-Concept Gladiators Trier will embark on their longest away trip in recent history, traveling over 4,000 kilometers to face the BC Batumi in Tiflis, Georgia. The team will depart for the 6th game of the FIBA Europe Cup and aim to start the second round of the group stage with a win. In the first meeting between the two teams, the Gladiators secured a 92:59 victory at home, and since then, Batumi has lost all their remaining group stage games, sitting at the bottom of the table. The Gladiators, on the other hand, have been dominant in the group, leading all relevant team statistics. The team will be led by Giorgi Ochkhikidze, who averages 16 points per game, followed by Larry Howell with 12.8 points per game, and Carson Basham with 10 points and 6.8 rebounds per game. The game will be broadcast on swr.de/sport, tagesschau.de, the SWR YouTube channel, and the ARD Mediathek.

### Rasta Vechta Earns First Win in Basketball Champions League

Rasta Vechta secured their first win in the Basketball Champions League with a 90-85 victory over Hapoel Maoz Daniel Holon on November 10. The game was played in Samokov, Bulgaria, due to the security situation in Israel. Vechta took an early lead, with a 14-4 start in the 5th minute, and maintained a 19-point lead at one point. However, Hapoel Holon's Lester Medford scored 20 points in the second half, bringing the score to 85-86 with 33 seconds remaining. Justin Edler-Davis made four crucial free throws, secured a rebound, and stole the ball to secure Vechta's first win. Head Coach Christian Held praised his team's defensive effort in the fourth quarter, but noted that they had struggled with ball control and turnovers throughout the game.

### Rostock Seawolves Fall to Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana in Eurocup

The Rostock Seawolves suffered a 71-88 defeat at home to Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana in the Eurocup. The Norddeutsche team, who had two wins and five losses, struggled with fatigue and energy levels after a tough stretch of five games in a short period. Coach Przemysław Frasunkiewicz attributed the loss to his team's exhaustion, saying they were 'a bit tired' and 'always one step behind'. The visitors from Slovenia took control of the game in the second quarter, pulling away to a 31-22 lead. The Seawolves fought back, but Cedevita's experience and offense proved too much, leading to a 49-68 deficit. Zach Copeland and Philipp Hartwich both picked up fouls, with Copeland sitting out for a long stretch and Hartwich being forced to leave the game early. The Seawolves managed to cut the lead to nine points late in the game, but ultimately fell short.

### Alba Berlin Suffers First Loss in BCL Season

Alba Berlin suffered their first loss of the season in the Basketball Champions League, falling 75-83 to Surne Bilbao on Tuesday. The Berliners fought back from an 11-point deficit in the third quarter, but ultimately came up short in the crunch time. Alba captain Jonas Mattisseck played in his 500th game in the team's jersey, while teammate Jack Kayil returned from a muscle injury in his leg. The game was a close contest, with Alba trailing 39-45 at halftime. However, in the final 10 minutes, Bilbao's offense took over, and Alba was unable to convert their shots. The loss gives Bilbao the top spot in Group G, but Alba still has two games left in December to turn the tide.

### Alba Berlin Suffer First Champions League Defeat to Surne Bilbao

Alba Berlin suffered their first defeat in the Champions League, losing 75:83 to Surne Bilbao. The result may have cost Alba the top spot in Group G, as Bilbao moved ahead of them in the table due to a better head-to-head record. Alba had won the first game 103:100. Brandon Angel led Alba with 19 points, while Justin Bean added 13. Youngster Jack Kayil made his comeback after a calf injury, scoring no points. Alba dominated the defense, but made too many mistakes, allowing Bilbao to score easily through fast breaks. The game was close until the final minutes, when Alba failed to score and Bilbao took the win.

### Vechta's Wild 140-Minute Thriller Ends in Home Win

In a game with astonishing statistics, RASTA Vechta edged out Basket Duisburg 83-77 in the Jugend Basketball Bundes (JBBL) A-Division West on the first day of the group phase. The U16 teams combined for 180 shots, 136 rebounds, 63 turnovers, and 37 steals, with the game lasting two hours and ten minutes. Vechta trailed 35-46 in the 21st minute but turned the game around with a strong fourth quarter, including a 17-2 run that gave them a 76-66 lead. Till Schäfers' three-pointer in the 39th minute nearly sealed the win, but the outcome remained uncertain until the end. Five Vechta players scored in double figures, with Jonathan Mulaj leading the team with 25 points. Stan Bart contributed 11 points, six assists, and six steals, while Kaan Moumin recorded a double-double with 11 points and 10 rebounds, plus five assists and four steals. Head Coach Jan Schneider praised the team's resilience and defensive effort in the fourth quarter, which ultimately secured the home win.

### Vechta's U19 Team Wins Derby Against Oldenburg

Rasta Vechta's U19 team won their first game in the A-Division of the Nachwuchs Basketball Bundesliga with an 86-81 victory over Baskets Juniors Oldenburg. The team struggled for most of the game, but a strong third quarter with a 17-2 run and a 25-8 performance in the fourth quarter sealed the win. Jonas Langermann had 18 points, six steals, five rebounds, and three assists, while Moritz Grüß was the top scorer with 23 points. Assistant Coach Lennard Stechmann praised the team's performance in the third quarter, but noted that they need to work on their individual and team performance in the other quarters. The team's shooting percentages were 44% from the field, 55% from two-pointers, 30% from three-pointers, and 75% from the free throw line. The game was played on November 10, 2026, and was a derby match between Vechta and Oldenburg.
